_doc: One file for every style: the caption script and beat timing. Keys under the top level are films (one per mechanism). Per film: title (short name), alt (one-paragraph text alternative for screen readers), verdict (1-based beat whose finished frame is the poster and the reduced-motion still), beats. Per beat: title (2-4 words, shown on the step rail), caption (the exact sentence under the picture; identical in every style), dur (seconds), still (seconds into the beat of its finished frame, where a paused step jump lands), picture (every word that will be written ON the picture during this beat, space separated), reveals (optional: beat-local seconds at which each new group of picture words appears). Checked by scripts/common/pace_check.py.

film1.title: Ticket routing
film1.alt: Animation in three steps. A support ticket arrives in the shared inbox. Written rules read its product and urgency and send it to the right queue. A person checks the queue before anyone replies.

beats.title: Ticket arrives
beats.caption: A customer's ticket lands in the shared inbox, with the product and the account attached.

beats.title: Rules route it
beats.caption: Written rules read the product and the urgency, and send the ticket to one queue. The same ticket always goes to the same queue.

beats.title: A person checks
beats.caption: A team lead checks the queue before anyone replies. The rules sort; people decide.
